description:
Finds places by what they are, name, street address or locality, at most 20, with coordinates and the geoHash and id get_place takes.
query matches the first word of a place's category (barber finds a barber shop; salon misses a hair salon) or a word of its name, not its address (use address for streets). Each term is a prefix of 3+ characters; a shorter one is ignored and appliedTerms lists what matched.
With latitude and longitude: nearest first within radiusKm (default 5, max 50), and no country unless you pass countryCode. A point alone is refused or returns nothing.
Without a point the search stays in one country: pass countryCode when you know the user's, because the default is the caller's network country, for a hosted agent the provider's.
claimedOnly keeps claimed places, the only ones that can take bookings; get_place says whether one does. Requires a signed-in user.

address.description: Street address, or its beginning. Example: Rynok Square.

claimedOnly.description: true keeps only claimed places, the only ones that can take bookings; get_place says whether one does.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country to search in, e.g. UA. Without a point it defaults to the caller's network country.

latitude.description: Latitude of the point to search around, between -90 and 90; send it with longitude.

longitude.description: Longitude of the point to search around, between -180 and 180; send it with latitude.

name.description: Place name, or its beginning. Example: Kava.

query.description: What the place is, or the start of its name; not its street. Example: barber, yoga, dentist.

radiusKm.description: Radius in kilometers around the point, default 5, at most 50; needs latitude and longitude.

name: search_places

appliedTerms.description: The search terms actually matched; a term shorter than 3 characters is dropped and absent here.

places.description: Matching places, most relevant first, at most 20.

claimStatus.description: CLAIMED when a business runs the place on Pinsvit, else UNCLAIMED.

geoHash.description: GeoHash of the place; identifies the place together with id.

id.description: Place id; pass it with geoHash to get_place.

latitude.description: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees; use it as centerLat for the search tools.

longitude.description: Longitude, WGS84 decimal degrees; use it as centerLng for the search tools.

status.description: The venue's operating status as imported, e.g. open or closed; absent when unknown.

url.description: Public page of the place; absent for an unclaimed place, which has no page.

title: Search places by what, name or where
